author: Susan Jenkins
text: I had similar issues with the before new scanner and my old phone. It does alarm and tell me that it has lost contact when my phone is in my pocket?  When you are connected open your settings and check and see if you can see the Bluetooth connection /address. I turn the app off then on and it will connect. I also have a reader. I prefer my phone
